_comment: Toggle registry for pi.dev extensions vendored under ../extensions. Deny-by-default (rubric #8/#10). Tiers: stable (L3, tested) | experimental (gate hard) | egress (publishes off-machine; command-only, never autorun). See docs/EXTENSION_REVIEW.md.

memctx.note: HIGH ctx-efficient memory. Best first port. ENABLED.

hermes-memory.note: HIGH cross-session facts/skills. Staged alongside memctx. ENABLED.

delegate.note: Subagent isolation. Needs the multi-step loop fix in index.ts first.

llm-wiki.note: Research-org vault + model-callable recall/search/capture tools. ENABLED.

thread-engine.note: GATE HARD: dead upstream repo, no tests, ungated Z/L autonomy. Never enable zero-touch/long-running without an approval gate.

share-redacted-gist.note: Publishes redacted sessions to GitHub Gist / HF (irreversible). Manual command only; never autorun.
